note: Structured intraday index calls parsed from public channel posts and scored against the index's own daily bars. A call fills at its stated entry, then whichever of the stated stoploss or first target the price reaches first decides it. Calls still open are counted separately, not as wins.

cautions.index_only: Only the INDEX call is scored. The option leg, the premium paid and the charges are not modelled - a call can be right on the index and still lose money on the instrument it named.
cautions.daily_bars: Scoring uses daily high and low, so intraday sequence is unknown. When one session touches both the stop and the target the call is marked ambiguous and excluded from the hit rate rather than guessed.
cautions.small_sample: Below 10 resolved calls no hit rate is published. A 3-of-4 run is not a track record.
cautions.inconsistent: A call whose target sits on the wrong side of its own stoploss is counted separately, not scored. It is not a bad outcome, it is a post that cannot be acted on as written.
cautions.unparseable: Only posts containing an entry, an SL and a target are parsed. Vague posts - 'rocked', 'get ready' - cannot be scored and are not counted against the channel either.
